description.en: Reads a temporary bit flag. Temporary bit flags are a separate table of 128 bits (numbers 0 to 127) in the flag data, used by the system scripts for short-lived states (by the name; when they are cleared was not traced).

true if the flag is set, false otherwise (also false if the flag data is not available).
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Testing a temporary flag (not found in script_clean/; invented)
